Not afraid to take risks, or go where angels fear to tread. Stubborn and headstrong, if not foolhardy at times. Courageous in adversity, fearless and adventurous, with boundless energy. \\n\\nOften accused of lacking patience, they want everything to happen quickly or yesterday. A tendency to be arrogant and argumentative at worst. Their remarkable will power, never say die attitude, and determination is most admirable. Rarely two faced or dishonest, though not short in expressing their opinions. A leader and a pioneer, a power seeker. If they can tap into their passionate side, avoid being reckless, steer clear of precarious situations, there is literally nothing they cannot accomplish.\",\"taurus\":\"Reliable, practical, and dependable, loyal and stable, calm and generally placid creatures. Though when they see red or their temper gets the better of them - they are the proverbial bull in the china shop. Their patience is legendary, as is their stubbornness and laziness.  \\n\\nRuled by Venus, the planet of romance and attractiveness, an appreciation of beauty, a nose for making money and security conscious, who enjoy the finer things in life. Material things matter, the plusher the better. Not a risk taker and often cautious by nature. Nor the promiscuous type, once they fall in love and feel safe, a more loyal and devoted partner from start to end. The answer to making their life work, take a leap of faith.\",\"gemini\":\"The qualities of this sign are too numerous to mention. Intelligent, extremely witty, bright and breezy. There is rarely a dull moment, and great company. \\n\\nThe capacity to think on their feet, an excellent communicator, clever and chatty, a brilliant mind, nimble and agile, flexible and adaptable. Mercurial and fickle too, with a dual personality- not quite Jekyll and Hyde, but there is a measure of inconsistency, and inability to express themselves emotionally or take themselves seriously. \\n\\nThis is the wild card of the Zodiac. Freedom is important, there is a phobia of being tied down- if you give them enough rope, they will always come back. To make their life work, they must devote their time to one single thing, and master it.\",\"cancer\":\"Sensitive and overly protective, highly emotional and very touchy, with an innate need for security. Surely one of the most caring and compassionate of the Zodiac signs. Don’t get the impression that they are a complete pushover. Both the male and female of the species are fiercely ambitious, and show a sense of purpose in whatever they do. Loyal and sympathetic, with the best of intentions, everything is based on their feeling. \\n\\nIt is a complex sign, moody and clingy on the one hand, and a general mistrust in humans. Passionate and physical. The crab tends to move sideways, has a hard shell, but soft underbelly. The best advice is to follow their remarkable instincts, even if it leads to a wild ride.\",\"leo\":\"Generous and kindhearted, charismatic and self-confident, who absolutely love being in the spotlight, and center of attention, and of course being appreciated. They are not the pompous, bossy boots often portrayed, though inappropriate treatment does not go down well to the most regal of signs. They adore drama, again the strong desire to be noticed is ever present. There is another side, they are not all lazy and indolent, or expect everyone to bow at their feet. \\n\\nIn affairs of the heart, they are ardent, amorous, sex kittens, the ultimate seducer or seductress of the Zodiac, who will shower you with presents. The advice for a perfect life is to prove how dependable you are, and never fear rejection.\",\"virgo\":\"Their reliability and practicality is second to none, with a highly intelligent and analytical mind. Dedicated and discipline, extremely caring and considerate, with a strong work ethic and sense of duty. Who else is going to clear up everyone’s mess? \\n\\nFussy and fastidious to say the least. The critic, cynic, workaholic, hypochondriac, and perfectionist of the Zodiac. But modest and unassuming, and never afraid to get their hands dirty. Meticulous to a fault, everything has to be done right, but are rarely seen bragging about their accomplishments. Modest and unassuming. Not one to complain when the going gets tough- the tougher the job the better. \\n\\nThe best advice, not to put so much pressure on themselves, and remember to enjoy a happy personal too, it’s not all work and no play.\",\"libra\":\"Symbolised by the scales, their sense of justice and fairness is of paramount importance. So is their need for peace and harmony, though the scales are not always so perfectly balance. Indecisiveness is a bug bear, on the surface there is no substance, too wishy washy. Appearances are deceptive. Actually they are stunningly intelligent, the personification of charm. \\n\\nRuled by Venus, the planet of romance and attractiveness- flirtatious yes, they have got it down to an art form. Well-loved and social butterflies, moving from one choice flower to the next, they adore being surrounded by beauty, and are the first on everyone’s invitation list. The most important thing is to be yourself, even if you ruffle a few feathers.\",\"scorpio\":\"Secretive and intensely private at times, but completely trustworthy and faithful, who will stand by their promise. But, and it’s a big but, the Sting in the Scorpio tail is no fable, especially if they feel a sense of betrayal. They will get even in the end, if anyone has the temerity to harm them. Revenge is sweet. \\n\\nThis is however, one of the most frequently misunderstood of the Zodiac Signs. An ambitious lot, except you would never know it. Emotions run deep, but prone to jealousy and possessiveness. Sex appeal, they ooze it. Do not gaze too deeply into their eyes. The best advice, is stop being so mysterious, and entrust others with your deepest and innermost feelings.\",\"sagittarius\":\"They are known to be generous, in abundance, everything to excess, supremely optimistic, a bit of a risk taker and gambler, and amongst the adventurous of all the Signs. Luck just follows them, which has something to do with always spotting the right opportunity, they won’t miss a chance or a trick, they seldom think twice. \\n\\nThough there is a tendency to make mistakes by being too overconfident, and occasionally reckless. Always look on the bright side of life is their motto, but are not the frivolous pranksters or jokers frequently portrayed. They are the deep thinkers and philosophists, who are far sighted and open minded, there is a silver lining in every cloud. Be more wary about pushing one’s luck too far.\",\"capricorn\":\"One thing that is worth mentioning is that as Capricorn becomes older, they appear younger. It’s a trick of nature. They are practical and responsible, patient and disciplined with an ambitious streak. They are nearly always successful, and manage to overcome any obstacles, even if the goat occasionally stumbles. \\n\\nNo one is more reliable, and nothing is impossible to them. Sometimes inclined to be cold and distant, they don’t open up easily, and demand respect. Too serious at times, too much of a realist, they need to let loose a bit, express their feeling more, and understand that being right is overrated. It’s hard for the best of us to maintain the highest standards. Though their persistence pays off every time.\",\"aquarius\":\"Honesty and truthfulness are the number one qualities. The humanitarian of the Zodiac, you couldn’t wish for a better friend- in groups or one to one, they get along with everyone. Rules and regulations go out the window, totally original and flexible, innovative and intellectual, some would say neurotic and totally eccentric, a born rebel and completely unconventional, even unruly at time. \\n\\nHowever, they provide hope and inspiration, and the world needs more people like that. Though emotionally detached, the Water bearer truly cares and understands what it is to suffer. To live life to the full, they must not take setbacks and disappointments to heart. A tendency to shock and tease, but they have all the necessary attributes to turn their fantasies into reality.\",\"pisces\":\"Meek, mild, timid, and placid, not a harmful bone in their body. A tendency to day dream and not face reality. A gentle and sensitive soul, the most spiritual and possibly intuitive of all the Signs. Sensual and romantic. They excel at anything creative, be it art, literature, acting or music. Low maintenance and unpretentious, though occasionally hopeless with money. Totally naïve at times, a sucker for a pretty face, and the waifs and stray in this world. \\n\\nCruelty and injustice is something they hate. Completely selfless and self-sacrificing, the role of the martyr is not unusual. The answer is not to be fooled, again and again. Helping others comes naturally.
